text: right, new project. combwatch is a small service for our beekeeping co-op. forty hives on six yards each sit on a scale that drops a reading file in a folder every ten minutes, weight and brood temperature. at the moment nothing reads those files. I want the service to store every reading and email the keepers a swarm warning when a hive loses weight fast. it has to be running before the spring flow in April.
reworded: Starting combwatch, a small service for the co-op's beekeepers. Forty hives across six yards have scales that save a reading file every ten minutes holding weight and brood temperature, and nothing processes them yet. The service should keep every reading and alert the keepers by email if a hive is shedding weight quickly, all live ahead of the April spring flow.
